required_inputs.snapshot: exact AuthoritySnapshot resolved by exact AuthorityRef; no latest/default/fuzzy fallback
required_inputs.release_ref: exact C11LogicalRelease ExactRef for the invocation
required_inputs.real_source_effect: exact bool and MUST be false

exact_match_semantics.refs: canonical PRE553 exact material equality over full kind/object_id/content_hash; no object-id-only, label, alias, hierarchy, latest, nearest, or wildcard match
exact_match_semantics.strings: exact canonical string equality after existing nonempty-string validation; no prefix, case-fold, label, or alias matching
exact_match_semantics.booleans: identity equality; only false is admissible for real_source_effect
exact_match_semantics.collections: required item must be an exact member of the frozen authority collection; omission is not unrestricted
exact_match_semantics.unrestricted_tokens: forbidden for release_refs, fixture_ids, permitted_uses, and real_source_effect in this authority family

load_bearing_owner_path.when: before a stable PositionedSubjectModelRule is constructed/admitted for use and before an invocation-specific PositionedSubjectPossibilityModelRule is assembled or passed into N10E provider execution
required_sequence: resolve exact owner-native authority snapshot from exact AuthorityRef
verify stable-rule ref/basis under the validated authority
only then assemble invocation rule with separate walkback authority and determinants

material.why_kind_specific_not_generic_extension: Only this new authority family carries fixture_ids/permitted_uses/real_source_effect as constitutive restrictive scope. Extending the generic API would broaden shared I01 behavior without evidence that other authority families require those dimensions.
material.real_source_effect_law: false is a ceiling, not a requested capability; true can never be authorized by this R2 candidate
